name: Invasion Percolation
desc: Fluid invades a random-threshold porous medium always through the weakest available pore, growing a ramified fractal cluster that strands dark trapped voids like oil fingering through rock, colored by invasion time from early violet to late gold and perpetually dissolving to regrow on fresh geology.

scale.doc: pore/cell size (higher = chunkier coarser medium, fewer cells)

density.doc: cluster mass / target fill fraction (higher = more of frame invaded)

speed.doc: invasion rate — cells invaded per frame (frontier advance speed)

hue.doc: time-flow palette base hue (violet start of the invasion-time ramp)

rough.doc: threshold-field roughness: low=smooth blobby lakes/few voids, high=spiky ramified fingering/many trapped voids

style.doc: render philosophy: iq violet->gold invasion-time / crude-brine duotone / blue->red thermal false-color / organic greens / mono black-ink cluster on cream print

seed.doc: deterministic medium + growth seed (rebuilds the random-threshold field)
